name: School Management System
description: Enterprise school management platform featuring academic sessions, class structure, CSV/Excel data migration, admission pipeline, student dossiers, attendance heatmaps, decoupled timetables, exam/CA scheduling, teacher gradebook, AI-drafted remarks with teacher sign-off, immutable report card snapshots, printable PDFs with QR verification, student portal, multi-child parent portal with combined and per-child fee ledgers, fast multi-role switcher, multi-channel broadcast messaging with live GSM/Unicode SMS cost guard, and class captain peer-leadership communication channels.
